pages.title: Saltwater Crocodile
pages.text: The saltwater crocodile ($(o)Crocodylus porosus$()) is the largest living reptile, reaching over 5 metres.$(br2)It lives in the rivers, mangroves and coasts of southern Asia and Australia, and can cross open sea between islands.$(br2)It will take almost any animal that comes to the water's edge.
